simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חָדֵל (H2310) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.

simple.summary: חָדֵל (châdêl) means vacant , i.e. ceasing or destitute First listed occurrence: Ezek 3 27.

definitions.full: H2310. chadel חָדֵל adjective forbearing, lacking , הֶחָדֵל as substantive Ezek 3:27 he that forbeareth (opposed to שׁמע , compare חָדֵל Qal near the end); construct אִישִׁים חֲדַל Isa 53:3 lacking men (i.e. forsaken by them); — ceasing, transient אָ֑נִי מֶהחָֿדֵל Psa 39:5 , but read rather חֶלֶד see Che critical note .
